Gives the address of each link as the page wrote it, beside the resolved address

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using Crawlberg;

var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(null);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.Links.Count);
Console.WriteLine(result.Links[0].OriginalUrl);
Console.WriteLine(result.Links[0].Url);
```
